title: Continual-MAE: Adaptive Distribution Masked Autoencoders for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
mechanism: Distribution-aware masking of uncertain tokens. Predictions on masked and unmasked target views must agree, and HOG features are reconstructed at masked positions.
adaptation: Mask 16 px patches where crack or inactive uncertainty is highest. Require consistency with the unmasked prediction, and reconstruct HOG of the 1-channel EL patch through a light head on the ResNet-34 encoder (trained jointly). Adapt per E1 module.
min_experiment: Arm: house/PF + joint HOG head (5 seeds), then masked-consistency TTA per E1 module. Baseline: SUP100-PF. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gains < +0.02, or test crack IoU or mIoU_rob drops > 0.005.
evidence: R: state of the art on four classification and segmentation CTTA benchmarks (numbers not retrieved).
prior_overlap: Partial. MIM pretraining on the 11.9k pool was n.d., but that was pretraining followed by fine-tuning, not test-time masked consistency on target cells.
